name: peerpulse-monorepo
description: PeerPulse P2P MSME Lending Platform Monorepo

scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --names "ACIE,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,cyan,emerald" "npm run start:acie" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names "ACIE,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,cyan,green" "npm run start:acie" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && pip install -r acie/requirements.txt
